messages:
zoe: heads up: onboarding CI is failing after SDK bump. embeddings call returns 401 in CI but curl to REST with bearer works locally. repo: github.com/redwood/sample-apps/onboard-demo

karim: that's odd. are tests using REDWOOD_API_KEY or REDWOOD_TOKEN?

zoe: REDWOOD_API_KEY (legacy). SDK constructor uses { apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY } in the quickstart.

lee: sdk v0.13 added alternate header flows for private installs and will emit X-Redwood-Key when apiKey is provided. Hosted gateway expects Authorization: Bearer. looks like the header fallback leaked into hosted path detection.

zoe: also saw embeddings call using param `batch` in sample code, but REST expects `batch_size`. SDK forwarded `batch` untouched so gateway ignored it and defaulted -> test flakiness.

karim: two parity issues: header name and param key drift. plus i noticed SDK retryer ignores Retry-After on 429 which caused hammering during load tests.

zoe: quickfix: update CI to hit REST directly with fetch and Authorization header, or set REDWOOD_TOKEN env and pass that to SDK. i'll push a [quickfix] now.

ops-bot: created issue #6123: "SDK parity: hosted header fallback, embeddings param name drift, honor Retry-After" assigned to @karim

lee: plan: revert hosted header fallback, normalize param aliases (accept batch and batch_size, prefer batch_size internally), make retryer honor Retry-After for 429/503, and add an e2e that runs quickstarts against hosted sandbox.

karim: i'll open a small patch for 0.13.1 today. will also add unit tests for env var names (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_TOKEN) and a short migration note.

qa: can we also log when SDK falls back to X- headers so we can detect regressions earlier? makes debugging faster.

lee: good idea. add a debug log at warn level when header fallback used. will include in PR.

zoe: thanks — pushing the CI quickfix now so onboarding tests are unblocked. will revert after release.
